entries.name: public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
entries.reason: The claims hook writes the claims; it is the issuer, not a consumer of them.

entries.name: apps/dashboard/lib/authz.ts
entries.reason: 23-6b: the gym_id claim is only a hint for which gym to ask about; public.authorize_action decides live (membership, status, support live gate). For a support actor the target gym must also equal the claim, which can only narrow access.

entries.name: apps/dashboard/lib/supabase/proxy.ts
entries.reason: 23-6b: app_role, gym_id and aal are read only to route (code step, gym picker); the access decision is session_gate_touch and the live database gate, never this claim read.
